Definition: from G3415 or G3403; recollection; by implication, recital:--mention, remembrance.
BiblicalUsage: Mneia is mention, remembrance — the word Paul uses when he tells the churches he carries them in his prayers. Without ceasing he makes mention of Rome, he does not cease to give thanks for Ephesus, and every time he remembers Philippi he thanks God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prayer that remembers people by name is the plainest love the letters show.
